description: This file defines a set of interfaces for grains in an Orleans-based distributed application, including grain identity, lifecycle, and communication methods.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Returns the unique key of the grain, either long or Guid based on the interface.

methods.name: GetLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the label associated with the grain.

methods.name: SetLabel
methods.description: Sets a label for the grain.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Obtains the runtime instance ID of the grain.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Gets the activation ID of the grain.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Returns a reference to the grain itself.

methods.name: TestRequestContext
methods.description: Tests request context, returning a tuple of strings.

methods.name: GetMultipleGrainInterfaces_Array
methods.description: Returns multiple grain interfaces as an array.

methods.name: GetMultipleGrainInterfaces_List
methods.description: Returns multiple grain interfaces as a list.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer (details depend on implementation).

methods.name: DoLongAction
methods.description: Performs a long-running action with a specified time span and string parameter.

methods.name: GetSiloAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the silo address hosting the grain.

methods.name: GetPrimaryForGrain
methods.description: Gets the primary silo address responsible for the grain.

methods.name: GetActivationAddress
methods.description: Gets the activation address for a given grain.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Notifies an observer; marked as OneWay.

methods.name: NotifyValueTask
methods.description: Asynchronous notification returning a ValueTask.

methods.name: ThrowsOneWay
methods.description: Method that throws an exception; marked as OneWay.

methods.name: ThrowsOneWayValueTask
methods.description: Throws exception in a ValueTask; marked as OneWay.

methods.name: NotifyOtherGrain
methods.description: Notifies another grain with an observer; returns bool.

methods.name: NotifyOtherGrainValueTask
methods.description: Notification with ValueTask, returning bool.

methods.name: GetOtherGrain
methods.description: Retrieves a reference to another grain.

methods.name: SendSignalTo
methods.description: Sends a signal to another grain; marked as OneWay.

methods.name: WaitForSignal
methods.description: Interleaved method waiting for a signal, returning number of signals and ID.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Sends a signal with an ID; marked as AlwaysInterleave.
